selection_process: The selection process will include shortlisting followed by an interview.

Applications will be examined by the school. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. Shortlisted candidates will initially be informed by telephone. An email will subsequently be sent with the interview date and time. The management's decision concerning the selection process will be final and binding.
how_to_apply: Visit the Army Public School Ambala Cantt website at apsambala.edu.in.
Download the prescribed application format for the recruitment.
Read the school advertisement and applicable AWES eligibility guidelines carefully.
Complete the application form with accurate personal, educational and experience details.
Attach attested copies of all relevant certificates.
Prepare a bank draft of ₹250 in favour of Army Public School, Ambala Cantt, payable at Ambala.
Place the completed application, certificates and bank draft in an envelope.
Send the application by post so that it reaches the school on or before 1 October 2026.
important_instructions: Applications must be submitted only in the format available on the school website. Incomplete applications will not be considered. Applications not submitted in the prescribed format will be rejected. The application must reach the school by the closing date; candidates should allow sufficient postal delivery time. The school reserves the right to fill all, some or none of the advertised posts. Only shortlisted applicants will receive an interview call. Candidates must provide a working telephone number and email address. No representation concerning rejected or incomplete applications will be entertained. The management's decision will be final and binding.

content_sections.heading: Army Public School Ambala Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: Note: The school has listed the available posts and subjects but has not announced the post-wise or total number of vacancies.

content_sections.heading: Educational Qualification
content_sections.text: Four-year integrated degree course from a Regional College of Education of NCERT in the concerned subject with at least 50% aggregate marks; or Postgraduate qualification with at least 50% marks and a three-year integrated B.Ed./M.Ed.; or Bachelor's degree with at least 50% marks in aggregate, with Sanskrit studied in all three years of graduation. B.Ed. from an NCTE-recognised institution or university with at least 50% marks. Proficiency in teaching through English and Hindi medium. Knowledge of computer applications. Bachelor's degree with at least 50% aggregate marks. The candidate must have studied any two subjects among History, Geography, Economics and Political Science. One of the two subjects must be History or Geography. B.Ed. from an NCTE-recognised institution or university with at least 50% marks. Proficiency in teaching through English and Hindi medium and knowledge of computer applications. Bachelor's degree in Mathematics with at least 50% aggregate marks. The candidate must have studied the required combination of subjects from Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Economics, Computer Science and Statistics. B.Ed. from an NCTE-recognised institution or university with at least 50% marks. Proficiency in English and Hindi medium and knowledge of computer applications. Bachelor's degree in Science with at least 50% aggregate marks. The candidate must have studied the prescribed combination of any two subjects from Botany, Zoology, Chemistry and Physics. B.Ed. from an NCTE-recognised institution or university with at least 50% marks. Proficiency in English and Hindi medium and knowledge of computer applications. Candidates must possess one of the recognised graduation-level Physical Education or sports qualifications prescribed under NCTE and Army Public School rules. This may include: Bachelor's degree with Physical Education as an elective subject and the prescribed minimum marks; or Graduation in Physical Education; or A three-year B.P.Ed. or equivalent qualification; or A recognised graduation qualification supported by the prescribed participation or achievement in sports. The applicant must also hold a B.P.Ed. of at least one-year duration or an equivalent qualification from an NCTE-recognised institution where required under the applicable route. Graduate with Psychology; or Graduate with a diploma in Counselling. The detailed guidelines prescribe a minimum of three years of experience as a Wellness Teacher or Counsellor. Bachelor's degree with at least 50% aggregate marks. B.El.Ed. or a two-year D.El.Ed. from an NCTE-recognised institution. Teachers already serving in Army Public Schools before 11 August 2023 with a B.Ed. may be considered subject to enrolment in or completion of the NCTE Bridge Course. Proficiency in teaching through English and Hindi medium. Knowledge of computer applications.

content_sections.heading: CSB Score Card and CTET/TET Requirements
content_sections.text: The following requirements apply to the advertised TGT and PRT teaching positions: The candidate must hold a valid CSB score card. Candidates who recently passed the CSB written examination must have obtained at least 50% marks. CTET or the appropriate State TET must be qualified with at least 60% marks. The applicant must also satisfy the applicable CBSE bye-laws and AWES rules and regulations.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit and Experience
content_sections.text: Age and experience will be determined as on 1 May 2026 . For experienced applicants, the teaching experience must be in the appropriate category and subject level as prescribed under AWES rules.

rows.experience_requirement: At least five years of teaching experience in the relevant category during the preceding 10 years

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process will include shortlisting followed by an interview. Applications will be examined by the school. Only shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. Shortlisted candidates will initially be informed by telephone. An email will subsequently be sent with the interview date and time. The management's decision concerning the selection process will be final and binding.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Applicants should attach attested copies of the relevant certificates with the prescribed application form. These may include: Proof of date of birth Graduation or postgraduate marksheets and certificates, as applicable B.Ed., B.El.Ed., D.El.Ed. or Physical Education qualification certificate, as applicable CSB score card CTET or State TET certificate Experience certificates, where applicable Psychology or Counselling qualification and experience certificates for the Counsellor post Computer qualification certificates for the Assistant Computer Lab Technician post Recent photograph and identity proof, if required in the prescribed form Bank draft of ₹250

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Applications must be submitted only in the format available on the school website. Incomplete applications will not be considered. Applications not submitted in the prescribed format will be rejected. The application must reach the school by the closing date; candidates should allow sufficient postal delivery time. The school reserves the right to fill all, some or none of the advertised posts. Only shortlisted applicants will receive an interview call. Candidates must provide a working telephone number and email address. No representation concerning rejected or incomplete applications will be entertained. The management's decision will be final and binding.

faq.question: Q1. What posts are available in Army Public School Ambala Cantt Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The recruitment includes TGT posts in Sanskrit, Social Science, Science, Mathematics and Physical Education, along with Counsellor, PRT Hindi and Assistant Computer Lab Technician positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies have been announced?
faq.answer: The advertisement lists the posts and subjects but does not specify the total or post-wise number of vacancies.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The application must reach Army Public School Ambala Cantt on or before 1 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. Is CTET or TET required for the teaching posts?
faq.answer: Yes. Applicants for the advertised TGT and PRT posts must have qualified CTET or the appropriate State TET with at least 60% marks. They must also satisfy the stated CSB score-card requirement.

faq.question: Q5. How can candidates apply for APS Ambala Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must download the application format from apsambala.edu.in and send the completed form, attested certificates and a ₹250 bank draft to the Principal, Army Public School, 60 Alexander Road, Ambala Cantt.
